snapshot: CivicState is beta-validation ready, not investible, until demand and deliverability prove out.

authority.adoptionNote: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

freshness.externalClaimsPolicy: All external market claims are tagged as assumptions in BUSINESS.md.

sourcesAndMethods.method: Read current product positioning, constraints, validation hurdles, pricing, and risks.
Read phase roadmap and completion narrative.
Read preserved product concept, architecture, exclusions, and older assumptions.
Checked implemented data model for users, submissions, campaigns, letters, officials, payments, deliveries, ledger, audit, agent logs, and jobs.

businessThesis.current: Validation-stage civic-tech product for paid, citation-backed constituent letters.
businessThesis.whyNow: The repo now has enough MVP surface to test the riskiest commercial assumptions.
businessThesis.whyNotYet: No production demand, revenue, deliverability, official coverage, or legal-review evidence exists in the workspace.

customer.primary: US residents with a concrete civic issue who want a drafted, cited letter sent to officials.
customer.excluded: Legal filings, legal advice, lobbying-firm services, enterprise advocacy CRM, community social network, and generic political social media.

real: Payment, delivery, webhook, treasury, admin, and compliance surfaces exist [evidence: app routes and worker agents].
notYetProven: Revenue is $0 in available workspace evidence [assumption: no Stripe export or production ledger present].
Traffic is 0 in available workspace evidence [assumption: no analytics export present].
Conversion, deliverability, and official coverage are planning hurdles, not measured facts [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].

marketSizing.betaCase: $360/month from 5 communities x 200 visitors x 3% conversion x $12 blended price [assumption: BUSINESS.md model].
marketSizing.operatorScaleCase: $120,000/year from 100 campaigns x 100 paid events x $12 blended price [assumption: BUSINESS.md model].
marketSizing.ventureScaleCandidate: $12,000,000/year from 1,000,000 paid events x $12 blended price [assumption: BUSINESS.md model].

competition: Resistbot [assumption: prior planning named substitute, external position not rechecked].
Quorum [assumption: category knowledge, no workspace source].
VoterVoice [assumption: category knowledge, no workspace source].
Capitol Canary or Phone2Action-style enterprise advocacy tools [assumption: category knowledge, no workspace source].
Manual email, official webforms, nonprofits, legal aid, and generic LLM drafting [assumption: substitute analysis].

holes: Frontend/API pricing tier mismatch may break non-single checkout.
mitigations: Run constrained paid beta before any BOS pitch.
Instrument funnel and delivery events before traffic growth.
Run official-coverage sample and deliverability harness.
Fix pricing tier integration before beta.
residualRisks: Consumers may refuse to pay for civic communication.
Government domains may classify AI-assisted letters as spam.
Citation, legal, or lobbying trust issues may kill adoption.
Official data freshness may be too expensive to maintain.

roadmapAlignment.buildableShape: Seven single-worker tasks trace to BUSINESS.md headings.
